 Print The romantic thriller movie 'Anbil Avan', starring Ashok Selvan and Preity Mukhundhan , is about to make its digital world premiere after its theatrical release earlier this month. The movie, which combines romance, family drama, and thriller received attention because of its unique story plot and action sequences. After completing its theatrical run, people who could not see the movie in theaters will soon see it digitally. The makers have officially announced the streaming details, providing an update for viewers waiting for its OTT premiere. 'Anbil Avan' OTT release confirmed for November 20
 According to the official announcement, 'Anbil Avan' will premiere on SonyLIV on November 20. The movie will be available in five languages – Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, and Hindi—enabling the audience to enjoy it in their preferred language. The digital launch follows almost seven weeks after its theatrical release on October 2. The movie's launch on the OTT platform will attract more attention, especially from fans of Ashok Selvan and Preity Mukhundhan.  Directed by debutant Karthikeyan, 'Anbil Avan' features Ashok Selvan and Preity Mukhundhan in the lead roles. The story was written by Vignesh Raja , who previously gained attention for directing 'Por Thozhil'. Revathy, Shabumon Abdusamad, Mahadevan Ganesh, Kathir, and Balu are also part of the supporting cast. Happy High Pictures and Ayngaran International jointly produced the film, while Govind Vasantha composed the music. The movie integrates elements of romance with the thriller genre as the main duo faces unforeseen circumstances during their romance. Join conversation

 According to Sacnilk, the film recorded over Rs. 8.83 crore total gross, with an India net collection of around Rs. 7.96 crore. 'Anbil Avan' story blends love, suspense, and a dangerous house
 'Anbil Avan' presents a couple having an ideal marriage after experiencing their love story. It is based on the story of a husband who fulfills his wife's dream by buying a private property in the hills, courtesy of Ashok Selvan's character. However, the couple's romantic life takes a surprise twist when they start facing eerie occurrences at their new home. The couple finds themselves dealing with some dangerous scenarios that affect their perfect marital journey. There is also one of the most thrilling scenes where Ashok Selvan jumps into the water from a height of 70 feet. 'Anbil Avan' comes to streaming platforms on November 20.
